title: Classic · salon grands
blurb: The instruments of the teaching studio, the salon and the small hall: six to seven feet, where most piano playing actually happens.

items.d: 6 ft 11 in · Steinway & Sons — the grand of the studio and the chamber hall.
6 ft 1 in · Yamaha — the conservatoire workhorse, in its third generation.
5 ft 11 in · Kawai — the mid-size GX, with a tapered soundboard and the Millennium III action.
7 ft · Bösendorfer — the Vienna Concert series, with the resonance case of the big instruments.
5 ft 1 in · Fazioli — the smallest grand from Sacile, built from the same materials as the F308.
6 ft 3 in · C. Bechstein — the Academy series, made in the same works as the concert grands.
6 ft 3 in · Blüthner — the salon grand, aliquot-strung like the Model 1.
5 ft 3 in · Petrof — the Czech grand from Hradec Králové, still built by the family firm.
